resolution.note: Operator chose (b) 2026-11-19: cost per resolved task, regression rate and per-record effect primary, pass rate secondary; recorded as ADR 0021 point 11 and plan item 5/S8.

title: Decide the S8 primary claim given the 73-unit pool cannot detect a 5 pp correctness effect
body:
Source: ADR 0021 point 10 (#1465, 787524a): with ~73 units the MDE is 16 pp (Holm); a 5 pp effect (literature upper estimate) needs 608-737 units; Remember-eligible later units give MDE 22.5 pp. Correctness "not shown" is the expected result of S8 as designed. Literature: .krn/runs/lead/night/proof-path.md.
Outcome: the operator decides between (a) expanding the unit pool about 10x before S8, or (b) making cost per resolved task, regression rate and per-record measured effect the primary claims with hidden-test pass rate secondary; ADR 0021 and plan item 5 record the choice. Lead recommendation: (b).
Files: docs/adr/0021-proof-methodology.md, docs/program/plan.md, evals/replay/abc.prereg.md
Proof: ADR 0021 names the primary claim and its MDE at the available n.
